svg.title: From Signed Authority to Earned Recovery Fees
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authorized-recovery-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Signed Authority to Earned Recovery Fees; subtitle: Five evidence-controlled stages for expense and tax-credit work; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Expense-recovery shares of 25%-50% apply only where permitted and contractually agreed. Federal tax work receives a separate scope and fee review. Client refunds, vendor bills, property values, and tax credits are not operator revenue.; caption: Preserve the original evidence before proposing corrections. A refund request is neither an issued refund nor an earned fee.; stages: label: Authorize and preserve; value: Signed authority plus immutable baseline; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Obtain a signed Letter of Authorization and fee agreement before disclosing tariff or refund findings. Snapshot invoices, payment records, carrier contracts, meter identifiers, assessment notices, and relevant employment records with timestamps and file hashes.; label: Extract and normalize; value: One traceable ledger per client; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Import FedEx and UPS EDI exports or permitted API records; use OCR for utility tariffs and cooling-tower meter evidence. Normalize account, invoice, service date, charge code, and payment status while retaining links to original documents.; label: Validate entitlement; value: Documented rule and recoverable amount; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check service-guarantee waivers, tariff effective dates, appeal deadlines, duplicate claims, and prior credits. For WOTC, verify statutory hire-date coverage, prescreening, certification timing, and substantiation before including a case in the recoverable pipeline.; label: Submit through authorized channels; value: Accepted submission with receipt evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use carrier-supported claim routes, utility refund procedures, licensed property-tax representation, or state workforce agency channels as applicable. Store submission identifiers and response deadlines; route rejections to a documented exception queue.; label: Reconcile and earn; value: Verified benefit matched to contract; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match issued refunds or realized savings to bank, vendor-credit, or billing evidence. Recognize only earned operator fees under the contract. For 36-month shared-savings arrangements, reconcile each period against a volume-adjusted baseline rather than booking all future savings immediately.

For WOTC, verify statutory hire-date coverage, prescreening, certification timing, and substantiation before including a case in the recoverable pipeline.

Store submission identifiers and response deadlines; route rejections to a documented exception queue.

Recognize only earned operator fees under the contract. For 36-month shared-savings arrangements, reconcile each period against a volume-adjusted baseline rather than booking all future savings immediately.

text.title: Match issued refunds or realized savings to bank, vendor-credit, or billing evidence. Recognize only earned operator fees under the contract. For 36-month shared-savings arrangements, reconcile each period against a volume-adjusted baseline rather than booking all future savings immediately.

Assumptions: Expense-recovery shares of 25%-50% apply only where permitted and contractually agreed. Federal tax work receives a separate scope and fee review. Client refunds, vendor bills, property values, and tax credits are not operator revenue.
